card.name: Section-number references and table symbols
card.fires_on: Small punctuation or number pieces in label formatting, mostly just before or inside section cross-references like (2.3) or 7.1, and footnote asterisks or repeated OR in dosing tables.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: The space or first digit just inside a parenthesized section reference to another part of the label.

modes.label: Table and footnote marks
modes.description: An asterisk, repeated OR, or x in dosing tables and lab-value lines.
modes.example: 0.3 mg once daily a OR<< OR>> 0.5 mg every 7

modes.label: Split section heading
modes.description: A letter inside a split-up section heading such as DRUG INTERACTIONS.
